findings.violated_requirement: speckit-plan Phase 1 step 3 requires a quickstart validation guide with prerequisites, setup commands, test/run commands, expected outcomes, and references to contracts/data model.
findings.observed_deficiency: The current required quickstart.md does not exist. References in plan.md do not supply runnable validation scenarios, and historical controlled copies are not current deliverables.
findings.exact_correction: Create specs/802-normalize-text/quickstart.md as a substantive validation/run guide: Python standard-library prerequisites; planned setup and unittest/run commands; exact-byte scenarios for FR-001 through FR-009 and the accepted examples; status/stderr/empty-stdout rejection checks; unchanged input and repeatability checks; references to contracts/cli.md and data-model.md. Preserve the reviewed design and nine accepted decisions. Identify future implementation commands as pending implementation; do not add implementation code, tasks, dependencies, or product choices.

resolved_review.PLAN-MISSING: Substantive technical context, pre/post constitution gates, nine-row design/validation mapping, SC coverage, structure and explicit O(n) memory risk.
resolved_review.RESEARCH-MISSING: Decisions, rationale and alternatives resolve literal LF splitting, ASCII trimming, strict Unicode preservation, original-input emptiness, binary I/O and whole-file atomicity. No unresolved research placeholders.
resolved_review.DATA-MODEL-MISSING: Transient input/result/rejection fields, validation and lifecycle preserve all nine policies; storage/migration explicitly unnecessary.
resolved_review.CLI-CONTRACT-MISSING: Exact one-path interface, no stdin/file writes, UTF-8 stdout and status/channel guarantees; all five accepted example cases plus Unicode preservation, trailing blanks and no size cap.

semantic_review.requirements: FR-001 through FR-009 consistently represented across plan, research, data model and CLI contract.
semantic_review.examples: CRLF trailing blank lines, bare CR, empty input, ASCII-space/tab-only nonempty input and retained trailing LF all agree with approved spec. Non-ASCII whitespace and decomposed Unicode remain preserved.
semantic_review.tradeoffs: Whole-file buffering and O(n) memory risk justified by avoiding partial output on decoding failure; no product cap invented.
semantic_review.constitution: Standard library only, local deterministic design, explicit human choices preserved, unittest/subprocess validation planned. No material constitutional deviation observed.
